scorecard.venue: Shaheed Veer Narayan Singh International Stadium

batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c JA Morkel b Z Khan

batting.name: DA Warner
batting.dismissal: c SS Tiwary b NM Coulter-Nile

batting.name: EJG Morgan
batting.dismissal: c NM Coulter-Nile b J Yadav

batting.name: KV Sharma
batting.dismissal: c J Yadav b NM Coulter-Nile

batting.name: Q de Kock
batting.dismissal: st NV Ojha b KV Sharma

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c KV Sharma b Parvez Rasool

balls.text: slow and low full toss on off, Bopara chips it down to long for one
full outside off, driven down to long off for one
yorker on the stumps now, flicked in the gap wide of square leg for two

almost taken at long on! It was a slower ball, shorter ball, Henriques slammed that ball straight down the ground and Tiwary ran to his left to try and catch it with his left hand but it deflected and landed outside the playing field
yorker on the off stump, he pushes it down towards the bowler on off
short ball on the leg side, edge off the ball goes high and lands well short of backward square leg
same treatment for the full delivery! He took a step down and flicked the ball from middle and leg over the cow corner for another clean six!
that short ball cuts in from outside off, Moises clears his front foot and launches that from the middle of the bat. It goes high and far for six
in the block hole on middle and leg, flicked to the midwicket region and they scamper back for two again
short ball on the stumps, mistimes the pull towards square leg for one
slower one on the off stump, Bopara goes across to turn it behind square on the leg side gently. He makes it back for the second with a dive despite an accurate throw
full, straight and Bopara makes room to drive that with some power down the ground. Straight bat and it beats a diving long off
back to the full delivery on the pads and he whips it with the wrists to deep square leg and that's his fifty
flat and wide again outside off, called a wide
flighted full toss on the legs again, flicked away wide of deep midwicket for two
too flat and short outside off, slapped down to long off for one more
he opens up and slams the full delivery on the stumps to long on
slightly slower on the pads, driven on the leg side off the legs
flat and outside off, slapped straight to cover off the back foot
the full delivery towards middle and leg is whipped to deep square leg. There's a fumble but no time for the second
drives the full delivery with the wrists a bit wide of long on for two in the gap
slower delivery is an offcutter outside off, thick outside edge goes into the covers
the short ball cutting in keeps a bit low as it's pull-swatted to deep square leg
fullish outside off, driven off the middle into the covers for one
slower delivery on length outside off, turned to the leg side with the wrists in the gap for two
full on the middle stump, that's very good batting and running as he pushes it down towards long on with soft hands for two more
run-out chance, but it's not a direct hit. He pushed the away-going delivery towards deep cover and they want two again. A not-so accurate throw means Moises makes it
flatter and fuller on the pads, clipped in the gap in deep midwicket and they run back for the second
too short from the leggie and Moises goes back to pull that from the middle of the bat to send that flying a few rows into the crowd at the midwicket boundary. Six!
flighted outside off, full as well, and he drives it down to long off for one
sweeps the fullish delivery from outside off to fine leg in the gap for two

he mistimes the short ball and Jayant takes a good catch running backwards. Karn made room, pulled the incoming short ball and it went on the off side off the edge, high enough for the point fielder to get under it
taps the short of length ball to short third man but he doesn't throw for the quick single as there's nobody backing up
bangs it in short as Karn makes room and he mistimes his pull, the ball lands well wide of Zak who runs from mid on
even shorter, Moises mistimes the pull and it goes high but falls well short of deep square leg as he runs in
short ball, Moises gets on top of that and hammers it with a pull to the midwicket boundary for a flat four to beat the fielder there
right in the block hole, but just outside off, Moises looks to block but misses
length delivery on the off stump, pushed to point and Moises denies the single
punches the back of length delivery between cover point and point off the back foot
slightly slower length delivery on off, turned to the leg side gently for two
charges down the track and slaps that from outside off to mid off
shorter on the pads now, he whips-scoops it over the in-field on the leg side for one more
on length on the stumps, Karn chips it over the covers in the gap for two
some room outside off, he cuts it fine to third man for one
bangs it in short with the angle towards off, he defends it to short cover
back of length outside the off stump, guides it late to third man for one
back of length outside off, dabbed towards the covers for one
towards middle and leg now from length, pushed back towards the bowler on leg
short ball outside off with a bit of angle, Karn guides that late and just wide of the keeper for four on the off side. Good bounce and he made full use of it
fullish outside off, driven into the covers
goes all the way now, that's six! Pitched up on leg stump now, Moises doesn't allow it to turn and slogs it wide of deep midwicket over the ropes
full and flighted outside off, Moises drives that firmly through the covers for two
turning towards leg from middle, helped towards backward square leg for one
shorter on the leg side and that's a smart shot from Karn as he tucks it fine on the leg side for a four
straightish on the pads, Karn goes back and helps it behind square on the leg side for two
length delivery outside off, pushed back to the bowler
turns in from outside off, Moises gets an inner edge as he looks to cut
holes out to long-off under pressure! He made a lot of room, Jayant pitched it up and Morgan lofted it straight towards long off where NCN dived forward to get his hands under it nicely
length delivery on middle and leg, defends to the leg side
pretty straight outside off, jabs it down to long on for one more
flighted on the pads, he works it gently towards midwicket for one
full on the pads, driven down the ground to long on for one
arm ball on the stumps, Moises goes back and punches that with one bounce over Mishra for one
googly outside off now, steered past point for one
the turn from off stump beats Morgan's reverse sweep and goes off the pad to short fine leg
pretty slow and straight outside off, slapped off the back foot to deep cover
fullish on the pads, flicked with the turn to leg for one
turning in from outside off, driven towards midwicket now
around off stump, he goes back and pushes it back again
even straighter outside off, pushed back to Jayant
well outside off now and not as much turn, Moises cuts it late towards third man for two
slightly flat and turning in towards middle, helped to midwicket
makes a lot of room and cuts the flat and short ball over point for one
charges down and drives that firmly to long off for one
makes a bit of room and pushes the full delivery to short cover
fullish on middle stump now, pushed back to JPD
fullish on the stumps and Morgan unleashes a reverse-sweep from the middle of the bat over short fine leg for a powerful four
too many of these falling safe after going in the air. Moises comes down, dabs the ball and chips it just wide of cover
drifting in towards leg stump, pushed down the ground to long off
pushes it in the air again, this one turned away from him and he steered it towards deep point
bit of flight towards the pads, helps it down to fine leg for one
turning in from outside off, driven down to long-on off the back foot
defends that short of length delivery uppishly past the bowler as it bounced and stopped a bit
sharp turn and some bounce as it comes in, Moises helps it to square leg now with the turn
turning in from outside off, pushed towards midwicket
chipped over midwicket and Morgan finishes the Powerplay by pulling that short ball gently over the in-field on the leg side for four
angling in towards the pads, clipped straight to square leg
touch back of length outside off, he steers it towards third man for one
bit of away movement now for the length delivery outside off, another edge from Morgan's bat - this goes towards point
length delivery angling in towards the off stump, pushed a bit wide of mid on with a drive for one
swings it well down the leg side for an easy wide
nipping in towards the batsman, thick inside edge goes down to fine leg for one
bit too short towards off and middle, Morgan turns it to the leg side off the back foot for one
short of length towards the off stump now, no room at all, and Morgan defends it back
superb inswinging delivery outside off, it comes in sharply, not too far from off stump, as Morgan shoulders arms
short ball towards the ribs now, he goes back and defends a bit awkwardly to square leg
back of length delivery towards middle stump, Morgan goes back and defends solidly

another catch for midwicket, two down! Warner gave the charge and heaved the fullish delivery, managed an inner edge to the leg side and Saurabh Tiwary at midwicket only had to jump and catch the ball over his head
towards middle and leg now, clipped off the pads to square leg for one
errs down the leg side for a wide past Warner

chipped to midwicket for such an easy catch! It was angling in from over the wicket, Dhawan looked to flick it in the air on the leg side but mistimed it and lobbed an easy catch for Morkel. No celebration for Zak
back of length around the off stump now, Dhawan stays back and helps it to point
towards the pads again, flicked straight to midwicket now
just over short fine leg! Pitched up on the pads, Dhawan flicks it late with the wrists and sends it flying a few inches over the fielder in the circle behind square
touch back of length and angling in, pushed back to the bowler
in the air but wide of mid-off! Length delivery outside the off stump, Dhawan drove it on the up and it went just to the right of mid-off, Duminy chased it from there and saved one
comes down the track, NCN lands it on back of length on the stumps, Warner gets a bottom edge and calls for a quick single as the ball bounces just over the stumps
little bit of width outside off, Warner guides it to point off the back foot
top edge for six! NCN threw in a bouncer towards Warner, who hooked and got a top-edge thick enough to send it over the fine leg boundary
full on the pads now, driven down straight to mid-on
angles the ball across the batsman outside off, Warner swings his bat but the ball doesn't bounce as much and misses the bottom edge
angling down leg again as Dhawan comes down the track to clip it to leg but misses and takes it on the pad
short ball angling in, Dhawan stays back and whips it off the pads to the fine-leg boundary as there's nobody in the deep. The ball lands just inside for a one-bounce four
movement away from the batsman outside off, Warner gets room and drives that off the back foot by going on his toes and sends it past point in the gap
beats him this time! Straighter delivery on middle stump, nice seam position as the ball takes off from back of length and beats Warner completely after he made room
fuller outside off, he leans forward and drives to mid-off this time
pretty straight on middle and leg stump, Warner waits and pushes it down to mid-on
full on middle and leg, driven down the ground to long off for one
thick edge as Warner drives away from his body, there is turn outside off and it goes for four by beating short third man
bit too full outside off, driven straight to cover point
not much turn so the full ball on middle is turned to mid on for one
full again on the stumps, driven down just past the bowler for one
tossed up outside off, driven through the covers for one
it's a dot ball as KJ drills the full delivery down the ground and Ishant stops. He then throws the ball high in the air to celebrate. 16 conceded by him in his last two overs
full delivery now, doesn't time the slog on the leg side as it goes along the ground to deep midwicket

dropped at short fine leg, very tough chance though. Poor short delivery, KJ mistimes it again and it went to the right of PK. He put in a dive but couldn't hold on to it when he landed and one more run

there's a run-out chance - KJ mistimed the pull off the short ball as it landed near the circle at midwicket region. They come back for the second by the time the fielder from the deep comes in and he doesn't get a direct hit
full on leg stump now, driven hard but straight to midwicket and they sneak in one
full and straight, Tiwary drills that hard and fast all along the ground, straight past Ishant who stands in the middle of the pitch to watch that go for four
inswinging low full toss hits his foot in front of leg stump, Bhuvi appeals but it's going down leg and they take a leg bye
full toss on the stumps, KJ mistimes the pull towards long on. Warner gets it, so only one
inswinging yorker on the pads, low full toss actually and he clips it to deep square leg. Tiwary ran for two from the beginning but KJ was happy with one
superb yorker under pressure on the off stump, he makes room and taps it to short third man
full toss deflects off the pad fine down leg, Ojha does great work to dive and keep it to two
short ball is slapped down towards long on with a top edge, Warner launches a flat throw so they can't think of a second
120kph, slower delivery towards the leg side to chase KJ as he makes room, inside edge hits the body and then goes fine on off for one
low full toss on off is driven straight to extra cover

gets the yorker but doesn't get the direct hit! Tiwary blocked the ball on leg and ran a long way for the single, Ishant picked it up and had a shy at the keeper's end but missed as the batsman was way outside the crease
short ball angling away just outside off, Tiwary pulls and misses as it bounces over the bat
doesn't move much and merely tucks the incoming delivery towards midwicket by closing the face of the bat for one
comes down the track, pulls with a top edge and it goes right over the keeper for a lucky boundary
fullish outside off again, driven down to long off for one
slammed over point, four more! It was almost a half-volley outside off, he got some room too and went down on a knee to drive that square in the air for his fifty
charges down this time but the away-swinging delivery from length beats his swing outside off
follows the wide yorker outside off and steers it wide of short third man with a horizontal bat for a clever four!
caught behind appeal from Ojha dn Bhuvi as he delivered it in the block hole just outside off, KJ made room to tap it on off but the sound was of bat hitting the ground
pretty full and well outside off, it swings a bit too as KJ swings and misses
chipped just over cover! He made some room but the ball followed him and he drove it inside out with an edge, managed to clear cover and find two
fullish on the pads, flicked wide of long on and he calls for two immediately. Jadhav makes sure they get two
slower ball down the leg side for a wide
high full toss around the waist and Jadhav pulls that on the leg side, six more! He's middling everything now, no way anyone could have thought it was going anywhere but for six
the bowler ducks, umpire ducks, long off dives and it goes for four! Low full toss on middle is driven over PK's head straight down the ground with such power long off can't get there
what a shot, that has sailed over the covers for a massive six! Jadhav made it look a bit effortless by timing that back of length ball beautifully from the middle of the bat
back of length outside off, punches it straight to point
comes down the track to slap that from just outside off to deep midwicket for one
touch fuller outside off, defends it into the covers again
short of length outside off, swishes at it to find cover
these short balls are not going to end, incoming for Jadhav, he goes back and pulls it well in the gap, wide of fine leg for four more
almost in the block hole with some outswing outside off, driven towards deep cover for two quick runs
short of length just outside off, turned on the leg side wide of long on in the gap for two
taps the ball late towards backward point for one
slow and short again, this time towards leg and he pulls that over midwicket, in the gap again for another powerful four
too short with enough room outside off, punched off the back foot as he had enough time to find the gap in the covers
almost stumped as Jadhav is beaten outside off, he was briefly outside the crease but made it back just in time
too slow and cutting in towards off stump, Jadhav opened the face of the bat so late and with such an angle that he was nearly bowled. But he connects and it goes fine on off for four

run out chance as Tiwary defends the ball towards silly point region, Jadhav comes halfway down the pitch. Ojha quickly collects the ball and throws to Karn but he doesn't collect it and Jadhav makes it
doesn't let it turn this time by dancing down the track and lofts that with a lot of power over long on for a big six!
loud appeal from Ojha, stifled from Karn as Tiwary inside-edged the ball onto his front pad as it turned in from length
turned down to long on against the turn for one
flattish and turning to leg from middle, helped with the angle behind square on leg for one
swept against the turn from outside off to deep backward square leg
leans forward and drives the ball to cover without letting it turn
that comes in sharply with the angle, no room and he somehow defends on the back foot
taps the ball late and fine on off, deflects off the keeper for one
flighted on off stump, pushed down to long off for one
drilled through the covers for four! He charged down, took it on the full and hammered that with a powerful drive to beat short cover and long off
turning towards the pads, tucked to square leg for one
loud appeal for lbw turned down! Tiwary leaned into the ball that pitched on length and came in slightly, struck in front of the stumps but given not out. Only reason could be he was a long way down
dangerous work on the back foot as the ball turns in and pushes it down just in time
googly from middle stump towards off, he goes back in the crease and defends
fullish on off stump, driven with the turn to midwicket

is that out? The bails are off..is he bowled or was it the keeper's gloves that took them off? There was no room as the ball turned in from just outside off, he went back to cut it and was beaten past the outside edge. Replays clearly show the ball dislodged the bails, big wicket this one
flat and outside off, he cuts that towards deep point for one
and again, he's gone for a low score by holing out to long on! Bit of flight on off stump, he came down the track and merely lofted the ball straight to Karn. He hardly had to move
doesn't middle the drive for the length ball back to the bowler
shorter and flatter towards off stump, Yuvi defends it on off
sliding in towards leg from middle stump, JPD helps it along to long on
flighted and low full toss on middle, flicked to short midwicket
flighted on middle stump, driven down with a straight bat to long off
googly on off with a bit of turn, Yuvi leans into it and blocks
flighted and full on the pads, tucked to square leg for an easy single
much fuller and he goes back to push it down to long on for one
leans forward and blocks the length delivery back to the bowler
gone now, misses the ball and he's stumped! He came down the track to loft the ball with the turn, the ball came in to beat his bat and Ojha whipped the bails off quickly
turning in from outside off, he chops that towards backward point, goes down a fourth of the pitch and keeps pressing for the single but JPD says no
dropped by the keeper, but very tough chance! JPD went on the back foot to cut the straighter delivery outside off, he got a bottom edge which came out of the keeper's gloves in no time
inside edges the low full toss, while trying to sweep it, onto his pad
turn outside off and he cuts it to deep point for one, and that's his fifty from only 29
goes back in the crease and tucks the ball from leg stump towards backward square leg
mistimes the fullish ball down the ground, it falls well short of long off
turning away from outside off, cuts it off the back foot to cover point
short ball after short ball, boundary after boundary for QDK! Short and on the leg side, he pivots on the back foot and finds the square-leg boundary with a powerful strike
slow and inswinging low full toss towards middle, drives it without much timing to mid on
this time he gets some room and guides it to third man for one
that's in the block hole just outside off, blocked on the off side for one
slower ball and almost in the block hole on off with some swing, inside edge gets them a quick signle on the off side
inswinging yorker on middle and leg, he digs it out on the leg side
short again, dispatched again! Goes towards off stump, eyes the short delivery and scoop-pulls that fine on the leg side far and away from short fine leg
misfield at point and QDK's cut off the back foot for the slower delivery finds the boundary on the off side. He waited for it to come to him, so did Bopara but the ball bounced just before him
fullish on the pads now, flicked straight to midwicket
shuffles across to whip it like a flamingo on leg but gets an inside edge on the pads
how to middle a pull, ask QDK! He gets another short ball and slaps it with disdain for another four. He's middling those!
short ball on the leg side, mistimes the pull between mid on and midwicket for one
absolutely accurate yorker on the middle stump, QDK blocks it back
129.6kph looked slower and was fuller outside off, QDK leaned into it and drilled that with a firm cover drive for another four
fullish outside off now, driven inside out to point
this time it's from the middle of the bat for four! Short ball coming in, he doesn't have to move much to smack that with a pull to the midwicket boundary
he shuffles across to the off side, PK replies with an away-swinging short ball but QDK has gone far enough to pull that over and wide of short fine leg for four
back of length delivery on the pads is tucked to short fine leg for one
comes down and whips it using his wrists past midwicket for one more
swept against the turn from off stump towards deep midwicket in the gap for two
makes room and goes in the crease to cut that off the back foot to point. A fumble from Dhawan concedes a single
doesn't move much and defends it from off back to the bowler
dances down the ground to launch that very high, with an edge, it's going down towards mid-off boundary and Ishant runs backwards but doesn't get there
bit of flight outside off, he leans forward and defends it
slightly fuller to QDK, he clips it towards midwicket and takes off for a quick single. Bopara doesn't get the direct hit
swinging in from outside leg, JPD tucks it off the hips to leg for one

superb bowling! This one skids into the batsman, moves in sharply and bounces extra as well. Iyer plays a nothing pull and ends up top-edging it for the bowler to take the return chance. Excellent start from Sunrisers bowlers
bouncer this time! This gets big on Iyer and he withdraws from the pull at the last moment
he keeps taking it away from the right-hander! This one beats the outside edge again. Iyer plays a loose shot there
another one beats the outside edge! It moves away from a length and Iyer has a waft at it
comes down the pitch and punches the length ball over cover to break the shackles
now he gets sucked into playing a pull, but this is a bit wider outside off and keeps going away from him, beaten again
another one beats the outside edge! This one is closer to the stumps and moves away just a touch to fly past the batsman's defence
extra bounce this time! This one takes off from a length and beats the outside edge
exactly the same line, outside off, but this time he decides to go along with the angle, cuts it powerfully behind point for another boundary
looks to pull it from outside off but this one slides under the bat.
length delivery on off, stays a touch low again, the batsman defends it down the pitch
stays on the back foot and tucks it towards midwicket
some inswing, Iyer wanted to whip it to the leg side but gets an inside edge on to his pads
that stayed a touch low! The batsman gets the toe end of his bat on this, dabs it close to the stumps and takes off for a single
he starts his IPL season with a superbly timed square cut! Lots of width provided and he slashes it through the tiny gap between point and cover point
shuffles across but the ball moves away from him, he defends it off the back foot in the end
